FlatBufferTypeRef.description: Payload-schema identity for a stream frame or an accepted port type.

SCHEMA_VERSION.description: Optional semver or schema revision string.

ROOT_TYPE.description: Optional root type name within the schema.

SCHEMA_HASH.description: Optional schema hash bytes for stronger compatibility checks.

ACCEPTS_ANY_FLATBUFFER.description: True when this port/type set accepts any FlatBuffer frame.

WIRE_FORMAT.description: Logical wire format for this accepted type.

FIXED_STRING_LENGTH.description: Fixed string length for aligned-binary string fields, when applicable.

BYTE_LENGTH.description: Byte length for fixed-size aligned-binary records, when applicable.

REQUIRED_ALIGNMENT.description: Required start alignment for aligned-binary records, when applicable.

TAB.description: Typed Arena Buffer — one descriptor for a payload slot in a shared arena.

OFFSET.description: Byte offset of the payload body within the arena.

SIZE.description: Byte length of the payload body.

ALIGNMENT.description: Required start alignment of the payload body (in bytes).

FRAME_ID.description: Optional opaque frame identifier for stream bookkeeping.

PORT_ID.description:
Optional port identifier for frames that route to/from a named
input or output port on a method (maps to
`PLG.PLGPortManifest.PORT_ID`). Empty for arena frames that carry
no port routing hint.

CCTCategory.description:
One ratified category in the taxonomy.

DISPLAY_NAME, SUMMARY and SLUG are required: a category cannot be published
without the label a surface will render, the sentence a browse row will
show, and the route a link will target. This is what stops each consumer
from inventing its own wording for the same code.

CODE.description: The ratified category code. This is the join key every consumer uses.

DISPLAY_NAME.description:
Canonical human-readable label, rendered verbatim. MUST equal the display
name stated in the CODE member's doc comment.

SUMMARY.description: One-sentence description shown on browse rows and category headers.

SLUG.description:
Route-safe identifier: the CODE identifier lowercased with `_` replaced by
`-`. Published explicitly rather than derived so every surface routes
identically.

DESCRIPTION.description: Longer editorial description for a category landing page.

PARENT.description:
Parent category for hierarchical browse. UNSPECIFIED means this is a
top-level category. A category MUST NOT name itself as its parent.

SORT_ORDER.description:
Presentation order within its parent, ascending. Ties break on
DISPLAY_NAME.

KEYWORDS.description:
Search synonyms and alternate phrasings that resolve to this category.
Feeds type-ahead; never rendered as the category label.

ICON_KEY.description:
Key of a self-hosted icon or capsule asset for this category. A KEY, not a
URL: consuming node surfaces load zero external-origin bytes, so the
consumer resolves this against its own local asset set.

CCTCategoryRollup.description:
An observed count of catalogue items in one category.

Counts are VOLATILE and are never part of the ratified taxonomy itself. A
rollup exists only with COUNTED_AT and SOURCE_CATALOG_ID, so a published
count can never omit when it was taken or what it was taken over. A consumer
that needs a live number computes it from the items; a consumer rendering a
published rollup MUST show it as of COUNTED_AT.

ITEM_COUNT.description:
Number of catalogue items whose PRIMARY_CATEGORY or CATEGORIES include
CODE, counted over SOURCE_CATALOG_ID at COUNTED_AT.

SOURCE_CATALOG_ID.description: Identifier of the catalogue the count was taken over.

COUNTED_AT.description: Unix seconds when the count was taken.

CCT.description:
$CCT — Capability Category Taxonomy.

The ratified set of capability classes that distributable units (modules,
applications, composed flows) are classified under, together with the labels
and routes every consuming surface renders. One published $CCT is the single
source of truth shared by a storefront, a library, a search index and the
unit manifests themselves.

Division of labour: `$CCT` = the category vocabulary and its presentation;
`$PLG` = one module's listing, which cites categories by code; `$APP` = one
application's manifest, which cites categories by code; `$PMM` = which
modules a provider serves; `$STO`/`$STF` = commerce.

TAXONOMY_ID.description: Stable identifier of this taxonomy publication.

VERSION.description: SemVer 2.0.0 version of the taxonomy content.

ISSUED_AT.description: Unix seconds when this taxonomy revision was issued.

CATEGORIES.description:
The ratified categories. Every capabilityClass member a consumer may
encounter SHOULD appear exactly once; a code appearing twice is invalid.

ROLLUPS.description:
Optional per-category item counts as observed over a named catalogue.
Absent means counts are computed by the consumer.

SIGNATURE.description: Signature from the publishing node key over the canonical taxonomy bytes.

PLGAcceptedTypeSet.description:
Accepted schema family for a port. When a port accepts multiple wire
formats (canonical FlatBuffer + aligned-binary), each ALLOWED_TYPE
entry carries its own TAB.FlatBufferTypeRef with the schema identity,
and the enclosing PLGPortManifest advertises both wire formats via
ALLOWED_WIRE_FORMATS. Per SDK contract: a port that advertises
aligned-binary MUST also advertise the canonical flatbuffer fallback
for the same schema and file identifier in the same set.

SET_ID.description: Stable type-set identifier within the port.

ALLOWED_TYPES.description: Specific FlatBuffer types accepted by the set.

ALLOWED_WIRE_FORMATS.description:
Wire formats this set accepts. If ALIGNED_BINARY is present,
FLATBUFFER MUST also be present for the same schemas.

DESCRIPTION.description: Human-readable explanation of the accepted schema family.

PLGPortManifest.description: One input or output port on a method.

PORT_ID.description: Stable port identifier within the method.

ACCEPTED_TYPE_SETS.description: Type sets accepted on this port.

MIN_STREAMS.description: Minimum number of streams that must be connected.

MAX_STREAMS.description: Maximum number of streams that may be connected.

REQUIRED.description: Whether the port must be connected for invocation.

PLGHostCapability.description: One host capability dependency (richer form of PluginCapability).

PLGTimerSpec.description: Timer entry declared by a plugin.

PLGProtocolSpec.description: Protocol handler declared by a plugin.

PLGBuildArtifact.description: Build artifact emitted by the plugin toolchain.

NAME.description: Function name as exported from WASM

PLGFlowNode.description:
One node in a composed flow graph. A degenerate flow IS a module: a leaf
module leaves the flow-graph fields on PLG empty; a composed flow populates
them. This is how flows reuse the module schema rather than a separate one.

NODE_ID.description: Stable node identifier within this flow

PLUGIN_ID.description: Plugin id of the module this node invokes

METHOD_ID.description: Method id invoked on the module

DISPATCH_MODEL.description:
Dispatch model: empty = linked-direct (in-wasm), "isomorphic" = an
independently instantiated signed WASM node, and "host-capability" = a
generic host adapter.

CONFIG.description: Opaque per-node configuration (FlatBuffer or raw bytes; never JSON)

CANONICAL_TYPE.description:
Canonical SDS identity carried by the edge. NOT `required`: an edge may
be opaque by design (see OPAQUE), and a signer must never be forced to
invent an identity to satisfy the schema. A contract MUST carry exactly
one of CANONICAL_TYPE or OPAQUE = true; a contract with neither, or with
both, is invalid and MUST be rejected by the compiler that signs the flow.

OPAQUE.description:
The edge carries bytes with no SDS identity BY DESIGN — an
application-blind host-capability adapter (an HTTP body, a raw file
chunk) or a timer TICK frame with no payload at all. This is a deliberate
signed assertion of opacity, which is why it is an explicit flag rather
than an absent CANONICAL_TYPE: a missing type must stay distinguishable
from a declared-opaque one. An opaque edge is ineligible for the aligned
route, so ALIGNED_ELIGIBLE MUST be false when OPAQUE is true.

PLGFlowEdge.description: One directed edge wiring a producer output port to a consumer input port.

CONTRACT.description:
Exact identity/layout and compile-time representation policy. NOT
`required`: marking a NEW field of an EXISTING table required makes the
FlatBuffers verifier reject every $PLG buffer written before 1.0.13,
which is a breaking change to a ratified standard. Presence is enforced
where it belongs — the flow compiler MUST refuse to SIGN a flow whose
edges lack a CONTRACT, and a verifier MUST reject a signed flow edge
without one. Buffers predating 1.0.13 stay readable and stay unsigned.

PLGFlowTrigger.description: One flow trigger (e.g. a host timer or HTTP route) that starts a drain.

DEFAULT_INTERVAL_MS.description: Default firing interval in milliseconds (timer triggers)

PLGFlowTriggerBinding.description: Binds a trigger to the node + input port it delivers its frame to.

PLG.description: Plugin Manifest - canonical signed storefront and WASM distribution record

TAGLINE.description: Short marketing summary shown in storefront listings

SUPPORT_URL.description: Support or helpdesk URL for this plugin

TAGS.description: Search and categorization tags for discovery

FEATURES.description: Short feature bullets highlighted in storefront listings

SCREENSHOT_URLS.description: Screenshot URLs showing the plugin in use

BANNER_URL.description: Optional hero/banner image URL for the listing

WASM_HASH.description: SHA256 hash of the decrypted WASM binary

WASM_SIZE.description: Size of decrypted WASM binary in bytes

WASM_CID.description: IPFS CID of the encrypted WASM binary

ENCRYPTED_WASM_HASH.description: SHA256 hash of the encrypted delivery artifact bytes

ENCRYPTED_WASM_SIZE.description: Size of the encrypted delivery artifact in bytes

ENTRY_FUNCTIONS.description: Entry point functions exported by the plugin

REQUIRED_SCHEMAS.description: FlatBuffer schemas required by this plugin

PROVIDER_PEER_ID.description: Peer ID of the plugin provider

PROVIDER_EPM_CID.description: IPFS CID of provider's EPM (Entity Profile Message)

ENCRYPTED.description: Whether the WASM binary is encrypted

REQUIRED_SCOPE.description: Canonical required scope for grant issuance

KEY_ID.description: Provider-local identifier for the module content key

MAX_GRANT_TIMEOUT_MS.description: Maximum grant timeout allowed for this module publication

CREATED_AT.description: Unix timestamp when plugin was created

UPDATED_AT.description: Unix timestamp when plugin was last updated

CHANGELOG_URL.description: URL to plugin changelog or release notes

PAYMENT_MODEL.description: Commercial model used for storefront purchase flows

PRICE_USD_CENTS.description: Price in USD cents for one-time purchase or subscription period

SUBSCRIPTION_PERIOD_DAYS.description: Subscription billing period length in days

LISTING_STATUS.description: Storefront publication state for this manifest version

SIGNATURE.description: Ed25519 signature from provider over manifest

INVOKE_SURFACES.description:
Canonical invoke surfaces this artifact exposes. A single plugin
MAY list both DIRECT and COMMAND when it supports both.

METHODS.description:
Rich per-method invoke manifests (port shape, drain semantics,
accepted wire formats). ENTRY_FUNCTIONS retains the slim
name+input_schemas+output_schema summary; METHODS carries the full
invoke-surface detail including aligned-binary advertisement.

HOST_CAPABILITIES.description:
Enum-typed host capability dependencies (richer than CAPABILITIES,
which is string-tagged metadata).

SCHEMAS_USED.description: FlatBuffer schemas this plugin depends on at the invoke surface.

BUILD_ARTIFACTS.description: Build artifacts emitted by the toolchain (WASM, bindings, etc.).

ALLOWED_XPUBS.description:
Allowed requester xpub identities (BIP-32 account xpubs) for module grants:
a requester whose verified EPM binds an xpub in this list is granted (PKI
identity authorization). Empty list = no xpub allowlist gate.

FLOW_NODES.description:
Composition graph (a degenerate flow is a module): the nodes this flow
invokes. Empty for a leaf module; populated for a composed flow. The flow
definition is this PLG FlatBuffer, not a bespoke JSON graph.

FLOW_EDGES.description: Composition-graph edges wiring node output ports to input ports.

FLOW_TRIGGERS.description: Flow triggers (timer/http) that start a drain.

FLOW_TRIGGER_BINDINGS.description: Bindings from triggers to the node + input port they deliver to.

PRIMARY_CATEGORY.description:
The one ratified $CCT category this module is shelved under. This is the
category a storefront capsule, a library shelf and a breadcrumb show when
exactly one must be chosen. UNSPECIFIED means the publisher did not
classify the module; a consumer renders it ungrouped and never guesses.

This supersedes PLUGIN_TYPE for all storefront, library and search
surfaces. PLUGIN_TYPE remains on the wire and is not removed, but its
`pluginCategory` vocabulary mixes capability families with node-internal
plumbing, carries a legacy vendor-derived member, holds a real family at
ordinal 0, and admits only one value. Canonical migration, applied by a
publisher rewriting an old manifest:
Sensor->SENSORS_AND_COVERAGE, Propagator->PROPAGATION,
Renderer->VISUALIZATION_AND_RENDERING,
Analysis->MISSION_DESIGN_AND_ANALYSIS,
DataSource->DATA_SOURCES_AND_INGEST, EW->ELECTRONIC_WARFARE,
Comms->RF_AND_COMMUNICATIONS, Physics->SPACE_ENVIRONMENT,
Shader->VISUALIZATION_AND_RENDERING, Parser->DATA_SOURCES_AND_INGEST,
Validator->DATA_VALIDATION_AND_QUALITY, Interpolator->PROPAGATION,
Exporter->DATA_SOURCES_AND_INGEST, Foundation->FOUNDATION_AND_MATH,
Infrastructure->NODE_INFRASTRUCTURE, Licensing->COMMERCE_AND_LICENSING,
Storefront->COMMERCE_AND_LICENSING, Publisher->NODE_INFRASTRUCTURE,
Basilisk->PROPAGATION, Maneuver->MANEUVER_PLANNING,
Flow->FLOW_AND_COMPOSITION, Unspecified->UNSPECIFIED.
The mapping is one-way: PRIMARY_CATEGORY is never back-derived into
PLUGIN_TYPE.

CATEGORIES.description:
Every ratified $CCT category this module belongs to, for browse, filter
and per-category counting. A module MAY carry several. If nonempty it
MUST include PRIMARY_CATEGORY. Codes MUST NOT repeat. An empty list with
a set PRIMARY_CATEGORY means the module belongs to that one category.

ENC.description: Encryption Header containing all parameters needed for decryption

EPHEMERAL_PUBLIC_KEY.description: Ephemeral public key for ECDH key agreement (32-65 bytes depending on algorithm)

NONCE_START.description: Random 12-byte nonce starting value. Incremented for each record in the stream to ensure unique nonces.

RECIPIENT_KEY_ID.description: Optional identifier for the recipient's public key (up to 32 bytes)

SCHEMA_HASH.description: Optional SHA-256 hash of the FlatBuffers schema (32 bytes)

ROOT_TYPE.description: Optional root type name from the schema

TIMESTAMP.description: Optional Unix timestamp (milliseconds) when encryption was performed

REQUESTER_XPUB.description: Requester account identity or wallet xpub

EXPIRES_AT.description: Grant expiration time in milliseconds since epoch

WRAPPED_CONTENT_KEY_HEADER.description: Encryption header for the recipient-specific wrapped content-key payload.

WRAPPED_CONTENT_KEY_PAYLOAD.description:
Encrypted FlatBuffer payload containing the recipient-specific content key
material. The payload currently uses `$KMF` semantics and is decrypted
using `WRAPPED_CONTENT_KEY_HEADER` before reading the key bytes.

GRANT_VERIFIER_PUBKEY.description: Provider public key used to verify the grant signature
